title: Minecraft Bone Meal Farm Tutorial - Small & Fast - 10,300 P/H!
description:
In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the NEW Cheaper, Smaller, Faster, And Most Important thing the new feature for cobblestones [CV2] Bone Meal Farm That Is simply Based On Moss Blocks and is self-sustaining! In Minecraft

📝Important Details About This Farm :
📚This Bonemeal Farm is so fast and can produce +10,320 Bonemeals Per Hour! but let me say that it might be affected on some servers because of the limitations that they applied 
📚This bonemeal farm is self-sustaining! and most important thing about this farm is that farm is 5x smaller and cheaper
📚this farm has a feature that makes chunk unloading problems easy to fix so that you can replace blocks so fast and so easily!
📚It's so easy to build you can build this farm only in 1 ~ 3 hours!
📚Unfortunately because of some game mechanics, this farm doesn't work on the bedrock edition

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
